title: Subdomain Visit Count
summary: Given an array of count-paired domains in the format "rep d1.d2.d3" or "rep d1.d2", where "rep" represents the number of visits to the domain and "d1.d2.d3" or "d1.d2" is the domain itself, generate an array of count-paired domains for each subdomain.
statement: Given an array of count-paired domains in the format "rep d1.d2.d3" or "rep d1.d2", where "rep" represents the number of visits to the domain and "d1.d2.d3" or "d1.d2" is the domain itself, generate an array of count-paired domains for each subdomain. The output should include the count-paired domains for all subdomains, including the original domain and its parent domains, with their respective visit counts.
constraints: Each input is count followed by a dot-separated domain.
Aggregate visits for each full domain and every suffix subdomain; output order is irrelevant.
hints: A visit to a domain contributes once to every suffix beginning at a label boundary.
Split each counted domain and accumulate all joined suffixes.
For index in labels, counts[labels[index:]] += count.
Every valid subdomain is exactly one such suffix, so accumulation neither misses nor invents visits.
editorial: Every valid subdomain is exactly one such suffix, so accumulation neither misses nor invents visits.

tests.explanation: All 9001 visits count for discuss.leetcode.com, leetcode.com, and com.
Shared suffixes such as mail.com and com receive summed counts.
